deadline.value: Applications are accepted all year (intakes in October, January, April and July), but funding deadlines apply. The first funding round is for applications submitted by early November, and applicants needing funding should apply by the January deadline at the latest. The President's PhD Scholarship rounds close 2 Nov 2026, 11 Jan 2027 and 1 Mar 2027. The department page still shows the 2026-27 dates.
deadline.quote: Applicants who apply by 23:59 (UK time) 2 November 2026 and are awarded a scholarship will be notified by 31 January 2027. | Applicants who apply by 23:59 (UK time) 11 January 2027 | Applicants who apply by 23:59 (UK time) 1 March 2027

also.quote: There will be an initial round of funding consideration for applications submitted by early November. We would particularly advise all students requiring funding to apply by the January deadline at the very latest.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Find potential supervisors and contact them directly to devise or discuss a project, then name them in your application. Your supervisor interviews you and decides whether to offer a place or nominate you for funding.
supervisor.quote: Contact your chosen supervisor(s) directly, to devise or discuss potential projects. | After your interview, your supervisor will inform you whether they are offering you a PhD position and/or nominating you for funding (if applicable).

funding.value: Funding comes from UK Research Councils, industry, college scholarships and the department. You are considered automatically for eligible college and department schemes, but you need your supervisor's nomination and a shortlisting panel decides. Look for home-government and industry funding too.
funding.quote: Students in the Department are funded from a variety of sources, including UK Research Councils, industry, College scholarships and Departmental funding. | Department-administered schemes involve an internal shortlisting panel.

entry_route.value: The minimum is a first-class bachelor's (or a 2:1 integrated master's), or a 2:1 bachelor's plus a standalone master's. If you fall short, your proposed supervisor can ask for a special case.
entry_route.quote: A first-class honours (or equivalent) in an undergraduate degree, or | Hold a 2:1 in an undergraduate degree, and are in receipt of, or due to receive, a standalone Master’s

notes: Every applicant has an online interview of at least 30 minutes with two academics before an offer is made, and a decision usually comes within 10-12 weeks. Scholarship applicants must keep the personal statement plus research proposal to 2 pages.
